question: $\vec{a}=2\hat{i}+3\hat{j}+6\hat{k}$, $\vec{b}=\lambda\vec{a}$, $|\vec{b}|=7$. Find the magnitude of $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}$.
explanation:
Because $\vec{b}$ is collinear with $\vec{a}$, the vectors are parallel.

The cross product of parallel vectors is zero.

Hence $|\vec{a} \times \vec{b}| = 0$.
